title: Contract the triangle counit normal form to the projection equation
statement: With the component notation of [def-sf-composition-projection-data], at every positive finite coefficient level and for each specified simultaneous system realization, leftMap equals rightMap for every supplied proper/open compactification triangle and arbitrary derived inputs K,L. Only the component equation is asserted: invertibility, joint naturality and three-cell associativity are separate arguments.

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7K; agent expansion of the blueprint composition/refinement calculation

proof.text: Work first in an arbitrary Calculus with TensorData. Expand alpha at components and factor both compactification projection words into a raw normal word followed by tensor of a pullback transport. Naturality of pi, delta and the compositors gives these factorizations. For finite coefficients use the existing proved finite triangle normal-form calculation. For systems derive this raw identity directly from properOpenProjectionMateSystems: insert the square isomorphism followed by its inverse, use naturality of gamma to move the inner open tensor map, and use first-variable naturality of the outer projection. The generic triangle_calculation pastes these two identities.

For proper composition use the proved generic projection_composition_normalized calculation and system_comp in RefinementProjectionProperComposition. A private abstract tensor API converts the curried calculation to TensorData without unfolding derived constructions. At finite coefficients rewrite the three tensor-isomorphism components using tensor_component_hom, then use the actual ambient tensor-composition equation. This preserves the native calculus arguments. For systems the same tensor hypothesis is supplied by ambientProperOpenPasting.

For open composition use properOpenTensor_comp at finite coefficients. For systems, form the composite open tensor isomorphism and transpose its inverse under the composite open adjunction. The projection_transpose normalization, pullback tensor composition and the conjugate open compositor identify it with the native composite open tensor map. These are the generic open_tensor_composite_transpose and open_tensor_transport calculations proved in ProperOpenProjectionMate. Only tensor and compositor isomorphisms are inverted, never a proper projection.

Use pullback associativity to show that the transport left after the left expansion equals that left after the right expansion. The finite associativity equation is part of ambientProperOpenPasting; the recorded system compositors satisfy integralSystemCompositorAssociativity. Postcompose the normal-form equality by this common transport and apply the two expansions. Everything for systems remains in the intrinsic system category before evaluation.
